summary.text: Yasmin Neal represents District 79 in the Georgia House of Representatives, and previously represented District 75 from 2011 to 2013, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Neal was born in Clayton County, Georgia, lives in Jonesboro, and graduated from Jonesboro High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice and police science from American Military University and an MBA from Strayer University in 2016.
Her career experience includes work as a police officer and investigator with the Clayton County Police Department.
